faq_heading: Westwood Plateau houses: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Westwood Plateau. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Westwood Plateau, Coquitlam: 57 houses listed at the end of October 2026 and 8 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 14%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. By listings that is number 3 of 23 Coquitlam communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Coquitlam total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Westwood Plateau fell from 61 in June to 57 in October (−6.6%), and 40 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 15.1% of Coquitlam’s 378 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Westwood Plateau?
Westwood Plateau also had 48 condos and townhomes listed and 6 sold in October, against 57 houses listed. The Westwood Plateau condos and townhomes page has those figures.

blocks.text: Westwood Plateau home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

57 houses sold in Westwood Plateau with a median price of $1,740,000 (the middle half sold between $1,630,000 and $1,900,000), taking a median of 30 days to sell at 95.9% of the last list price; 2% sold above list. They had a median $444 per square foot, a median year built of 1994 and a median lot of 6,996 square feet.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Westwood Plateau?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 57 houses listed in Westwood Plateau. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Westwood Plateau a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Westwood Plateau had a sales ratio of 14%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Westwood Plateau from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 40 houses sold in Westwood Plateau over those 5 months, out of 273 in all of Coquitlam.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Westwood Plateau?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Westwood Plateau sell for?
faq.a: 57 houses sold in Westwood Plateau between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,740,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Westwood Plateau?
faq.a: The median was 30 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 95.9% of the last list price (2% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
